notes.title: Silver Waffle v1.5 nods for mods
notes.content:
Silver Waffle v1.5 update brings support for mods

The game now includes a built-in mod editor, from where you can create and edit your mods, and submit them to the Steam workshop. This initial version allows you to replace 3d-models and their collision shapes, images, shaders, and sounds. For more information about modding Silver Waffle see Docs/Modding.html in the installed files for the game.


Modding competition

A modding competition will be held, with Steam keys to Silver Waffle for prices as follows:

 1st place: 5 keys
 2nd place: 3 keys
 3rd place: 2 keys


Participanting to the contest requires submitting a mod, players can then vote on it, and the winners will be determined by the number of votes.

Submitting a mod must be announced in a new thread on the General discussion group, one thread per mod. Include the name of your mod, and maybe a link to it, otherwise it's freeform what you want to say there.

Votes are cast on the mod submit thread by replying in the thread, the contents of the reply does not matter, all replies count as +1 vote, one vote per individual. The mod submitter is automatically counted as one vote.

All participants and voters must own the game when the results are calculated, this is verified by checking for the "mouse" icon in the relevant threads and replies.

Multiple mods can be submitted by the same person.

You must have the (copy)rights for the assets your mod contains, and the assets must be valid as per the Steam workshop terms of service.

You can keep updating your mod after submitting it for the competition.

I will send a temporary friend-invite in Steam for the winners to deliver the keys.

Important dates
Mod submit starts: immediately
Mod submit ends: 16th of April 2025, at 13:00 UTC
Voting ends: 23th of April 2025, at 13:00 UTC
Results are calculated and announced: 10th of May 2025, at 13:00 UTC

notes.title: v1.4
notes.content: Some minor changes in preparation for the modding/workshop support.

notes.title: v1.3
notes.content:
Added option in settings / user interface to do simple user interface scaling to fit the screen. When turned on all user interface elements (including the Solar System view) will be stretched and look pixelated in display resolutions higher than 1280x800.
 Fixed a case where player could obtain indestructible spaceship at the start of a new game.
 Fixed the fleet view to update when a spaceship is renamed from the spaceship menu (previously fleet was updated only when changed from the building menu).

notes.title: v1.2
notes.content:
Cities being rebuilt now show up as "rebuilding" in the city list.
 Greatly reduced the size of savegame files.
 Removed accidentally left in testing code that made first asteroid in space levels to come too soon.

notes.title: v1.1 on 2025-02-15T23:39:02+00:00
notes.content:
Changed the head in the "worm" hacking minigame to turn immediately when user changes direction.
 Changed the minimum length in the "worm" hacking minigame to be 3 (was 1).
 Fixed a case where the alien reinforcements would get stuck on the edge of the level.
 Fixed alien spaceships to use the correct behavior in space levels. Previously they would sometimes in space levels move incorrectly in the z-axis, making them impossible to be hit with players turret.
 Fixed loading saved games saved on different filesystem path than what they are loaded from.
 Fixed some text grammar.
 Fixed the fleet view to update when a spaceship is renamed.
 Fixed the reload sound effect for personal weapons (pistols, smg) after loading a saved game. The reload sound effect can be fixed by switching weapons after loading a savegame version 1.
 Removed the console command "debug" as it was not meant to be in the release build.
